core_meaning.primary_meaning: Habeel is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Powerful”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Habeel corresponds to the Arabic form هابيل (Arabic هابيل (Hābīl) < Hebrew הֶבֶל (Hevel)). Its core sense is abel (habīl / hābīl, son of adam). Habeel is the Arabic form هابيل (Hābīl) of the biblical name Abel, son of Adam. The name is Hebrew in ultimate origin and appears in Islamic tradition (Abel and Cain, the two sons of Adam); it is not itself the lexical sense 'powerful' that the source asserted. The source gave the Latin string 'Habeel' as the Urdu form.
